para: a common belief that is wrong, myth vs truth, what people think vs what is real, debunking
ficha: Glass card over the blurred photo: the false belief appears with a red X and gets struck through; on the hit the card flips and shows the truth with a check. Only when the narrator corrects a belief in this sentence. mito = the wrong belief, verdad = the correction exactly as the narrator says it; never invent a truth that is not said. Both short, in the language of the video. rot_mito / rot_verdad = tiny labels in the video's language (e.g. MITO / LA VERDAD).

para: a new section starts, step N, error N, reason N, a numbered point in a list, a big turn in the story
ficha: Fast full-screen pattern interrupt: a diagonal color band sweeps across, a giant number slams in and the title lands on the hit. Only when the sentence opens a numbered point. numero = the number said (1-2 digits), rotulo = one small word above it (ERROR, PASO, RAZÓN… in the video's language), titulo = the name of the point, spoken words only.

para: a strong sentence to remember, a warning, a promise, the key line of the video
ficha: The photo with a slow push; the spoken sentence enters word by word exactly with the voice at the bottom, and the hit words get a color block behind them. No data: it uses the words of the sentence. Best for a short, punchy sentence (under 14 words).

para: steps to follow, a routine, a recipe, 2-4 things to do or remember, save this
ficha: Glass card over the blurred photo: a small label, a title, and 2-4 numbered steps, each with a photo thumbnail, appearing when they are named. aviso = tiny label in the video's language (e.g. GUARDÁ ESTO), titulo = what the list is, pasos = the steps said, each t short, foto = the photo that shows that step, en = the word where it is named.

para: look at this detail, a small thing in the photo that matters, the sign to notice, where exactly
ficha: The full photo, then the camera pushes into one detail and a ring locks onto it on the hit, with its name in a label at the bottom. Pick a photo where that object is clearly visible; the renderer finds its exact place by looking at the photo. etiqueta = the spoken name of the detail. tono alerta = red ring for a danger.

para: we are on item N of a list, progress through several errors / tips / steps, what comes next
ficha: The photo stays visible and a glass panel slides in at the side with the whole list: the items already covered are struck through, the current one lights up on the hit, the coming ones stay blurred so they are not spoiled. Only when the video goes through a numbered list. titulo = the list name, items = all the items of the list in order (short, in the video's language), actual = the number of the current item, lado = side of the photo that is calm.
